correctness.rationale: On a finite connected graph aI+fL is a positive-definite irreducible nonsingular M-matrix, so its inverse times A is strictly positive. Put t=1/f. The resolvent is P/a+tL⁺+O(t²), with P=11ᵀ/n, and is analytic in t near zero. The limiting product before the Monod factor is 1dᵀ/(an), with simple nonzero Perron root d̄/a. Its first derivative is dᵀL⁺A1/(dᵀ1)=S/(n d̄). Multiplying by ξ/(1+t) gives the claimed coefficient and justifies differentiating the expansion for eventual monotonicity. On a star h has zero sum and is an eigenvector of L with eigenvalue m+1, giving S=m(m−1)²/(m+1)². The radial block has generalized eigen-polynomial a(a+(m+1)f)μ²−2mfμ−m, with one positive root; the leaf-difference directions are null for A. Inserting u=2m(1+f)/[a(m+1)f] into this polynomial and multiplying by the positive scale af²(m+1)²/m gives exactly −δf²+Bf+4am. This proves the stated strict comparison, its equality case and the crossing formula. Continuity and the endpoint limits prove finite attainment when there is overshoot. The exact witness gives P(6/25)=−44/25 and limit 4/21<1/5. The cooperative ODE is bounded on the occupancy cube, has a strict positive Perron subsolution when cΛ>e and a positive-left-Perron exponential upper bound when cΛ<e. As a separate graph check, on the four-path d̄=3/2 and S=1/2. Its symmetric two-class polynomial at a=30 is a(a+2f)μ²−(a+3f)μ−1; evaluation at f=10³,10⁴,10⁵ gives scaled differences f(Λ/ξ−1/20) about .0315354, .0331499 and .0333149, converging toward 1/30 as predicted. The analytic arguments, not these evaluations, certify the stated parameter ranges.
residual_risks: The graph-energy correction is only first order and does not settle equality for general graphs.
The ODE inference is deterministic, with equal capacities and the specified neighbor-birth saturation. It is not a stochastic survival-time result.

evidence: Strict increase to the limit implies every finite value is below it when s≤s_c. Above s_c, the decreasing side lies strictly above the limiting value, and the increasing side crosses it exactly once, since Λ(0+)=0. Substituting the limiting value into the shared closed form gives the frozen explicit crossing.

In the graph analogue, setting b=d gives the exact energy term S/(n d̄). At first order the diagonal birth factor diag(d) and A have the same left and right sums, hence the same limiting rank-one matrix and the same first derivative projected on its Perron vectors; the Monod factor adds −d̄/a. This matching of first-order terms is not a claim of equality of the finite-rate kernels.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The star threshold, crossing regime and rational type of viability witness do not survive as a distinct claim in the face of the stronger exact formula and monotonicity classification. The general-graph expansion remains a correct observation for the neighbor-birth model; it is not grounds to pass the frozen headline claim unchanged. The Bernardi passages support the underlying model and persistence criterion, not an earlier determination of this particular threshold.

originality.rationale: The central sharp star mortality threshold is demonstrably covered by a distinct indexed result, fbbc798f48aa, on the identical model and full parameter range. It gives the same capacity formula and threshold and strictly stronger all-rate monotonicity and uniqueness of the maximum. Its f_* is a maximizer, not the frozen record's crossing with the limiting capacity; the crossing is implied by the monotonicity and is obtained by direct algebra from the indexed closed form. A second indexed result gives a materially matching first-order graph-energy mechanism under different birth assumptions, not the exact neighbor-birth expansion as stated. This is a failure to establish the frozen headline finding as scientifically distinct from indexed coverage, not a finding of mathematical error or a determination that the indexed result was first. No narrowed replacement is submitted.
residual_risks: The demonstrable overlap does not determine historical priority, copying, or the relationship between the records.
No claim is made that the source-local catalogue result states the neighbor-birth high-exploration expansion in full. Bounded inspections do not establish the entire historical literature.

checked_sources: Bernardi et al. §II.3 and capacity criterion
value.rationale: The deterministic invasion observable and movement-rate comparison come directly from an ecological model rather than an isolated parameter exercise. The graph energy gives an interpretable test for whether the capacity approaches its limit from above or below, while the star threshold answers when stronger movement can reverse deterministic viability. This is a meaningful mathematical question and classification; the separately recorded originality failure means the already covered star threshold and alternate witness are not a distinct contribution.
residual_risks: No proof of analogous behavior for arbitrary birth laws, stochastic finite carrying capacity or arbitrary directed dispersal.
